proposed.text: A Type III-A office building (Group B occupancy, multi-story) has a tabular area (At) of 19,000 sq ft per IBC Table 506.2. The frontage increase factor (If) is calculated as 0.375, and the building has a full NFPA 13 sprinkler system. What is the allowable building area per floor (Aa)?
proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Option D (71,250) appears to use Is = 3.00 (single-story factor) on a multi-story building. This is a classic trap — always confirm whether the building is single-story or multi-story before selecting Is.
